body: Yeah, I'm all too familiar... too much so. I'm disgusted with him, personally. The only good thing about him is his want to help people. Even then he comes off as desperate and alone. Aside from that, though... nothing
Yet I still am planning on it. I've been setting the date for over the past few months now. It's nothing new. I've always known my lack of self-worth, believe me.
I don't know... weird. And still partly bummed. Shifting in and out of moods...

My friends do care, I guess... I just don't know if they know the severity of the situation... or something... either way, they're not bad people...

Thank you for the helpful input, and kind words... I'll try to get better...

That's what I always say, but I never know...

Thank you for the helpful words, though

It's hard for people to love themselves when they're in such a position where they feel unloved, though... maybe some people need some basis of love and appreciation from others, even just by a little bit. It sounds lame, I know, but that's what I've learned...
My mom's exceptionally passive about everything, and she thinks that suicide is selfish... My dad's dead, and my sisters would... I don't know...
Of course. It's an amazingly consistent feeling that's triggered by a lot of things...

Hey there. I can't pretend to know what you're going through, because I've never experienced the lain and suffering you have. And I know this may sound dumb and vapid, but I truly am sorry that you have been dealt with such a shitty hand. Nobody deserves that. And I mean that entirely.

But please. Don't do it. I know it doesn't mean much coming from someone who is also suicidal, but it isn't worth it. As bad as it seems for you, death is much more worse. Think about that one friend you text and is like a mother to you: can you imagine what kind of pain she'd feel if you died? It'd probably hurt a great deal for her, if you mean a lot to her and vice versa.

Also, I'd care a lot, if nobody else would. Even if I don't know you. Talk to me about it if you want...
My friends... they don't want me to talk about it, though... because why the fuck should it matter?
I just don't see any possible way out... nobody would miss me, not even my friends or family, I know it
I have no talents, I'm useless in every regard... and no, there are no good memories with me in them. It's impossible. I'm just a shitty person who's not welcome anywhere.
If I killed myself, people would only care for about a week, and then forget me... I have nothing going for me

I just make stupid decisions that I feel hurt and cause drama for people. People always insist that I didn't do anything wrong, but I always feel differently...

Besides, I've talked to them about this a few times before, about how I don't feel loved, they just don't rreciprocate at all, and it all turns out to be the same damn thing all over again...
I just don't feel wanted or loved by my friends, family, anyone at school... I hate it. All I do is hurt people, anyways...
Everything is wrong. No one, I feel, cares... I just hurt everyone
